Purpose & Why It's Needed: Authenticates a user by sending email and password. It sets an HTTP-only JWT cookie in the browser to maintain authentication across sessions.
Creates a brand new user account in the PostgreSQL database and automatically prepares them for login.
Clears the JWT auth cookie from the browser, deletes user cache from localStorage, and redirects to login.
Fetches the current authenticated user's complete profile details (name, summary, skills, location, role, profile picture, banner, and total profile views).
Fetches public profile data of any user by ID. If visited by another authenticated user, it automatically records a profile view.
Fetches the history of users who visited the logged-in user's profile, including viewer name, picture, and view timestamp for the Visibility settings tab.
Updates user profile and account credentials (name, email, password with verification, headline, bio, location, skills) and uploads avatar/banner images via multipart or JSON.
Retrieves feed posts including author details, likes count, comments count, and whether the logged-in user liked each post.
Creates a new post with text content and optional media upload (Cloudinary) and broadcasts it to feeds.
Updates post caption or content for a post owned by the logged-in user.
Deletes a post owned by the logged-in user from the database.
Toggles a like on a post (creates like if unliked, removes like if already liked) and returns updated like count.
Fetches the list of all users who liked a specific post, displaying their names, summaries, and avatars in the reactions modal.
Fetches top-level comments and replies for a specific post to render underneath the post.
Posts a new top-level comment or replies to an existing parent comment on a post.
Fetches career and educational experience records for the logged-in user or a visited profile.
Adds a new job/experience entry with company, role, dates, location, and description.
Updates an existing experience record by ID.
Deletes an experience entry by ID from the user's profile.
Searches registered users by name or keyword with pagination support for discovery and networking.
Fetches list of all platform users to suggest network connections and contacts.
Sends a connection invitation request to another user by user ID.
Accepts, rejects, or updates the status of an incoming connection request.
Fetches received requests, sent requests, and accepted connections/friends for networking.
Initiates or retrieves an existing direct 1-on-1 conversation channel between two users.
Fetches the authenticated user's active conversation threads, unread counts, and last messages.
Fetches participant members belonging to a specific conversation room.
Fetches paginated message history for a conversation thread.
Sends a new text message to a conversation via REST API (complements real-time Socket.IO emission).
Fetches all published job opportunities with filters, company info, salary ranges, and applicant counts.
Fetches detailed information for a specific job listing by job ID.
Publishes a new job vacancy with role, company name, location, salary range, employment type, and applicant limits.
Deletes a job posting authored by the logged-in user.
Submits an application for the authenticated user to a job posting, validating against duplicate applications and applicant limits.
Fetches list of applicants who submitted applications to jobs created by the authenticated user.
Fetches all active premium subscription plans and pricing tiers available for purchase.
Admin endpoint to create a new premium subscription plan with price, billing period, features, and currency.
Admin endpoint to update pricing, descriptions, and feature sets for an existing subscription plan.
Admin endpoint to deactivate/soft-delete a subscription plan so new users cannot subscribe.
Admin utility function to retrieve all subscription plans regardless of active status.
Admin utility function to reactivate a previously deactivated subscription plan.
Initiates a subscription purchase for a chosen plan ID, creating a pending subscription record awaiting payment.
Fetches the active subscription details and membership status for the logged-in user.
Cancels the authenticated user's active recurring subscription.
Processes payment for a pending subscription using payment method and idempotency key to prevent double charging.
